Maria: Quick sync request — BluePeak private deployment review. Need ~30m to cover VPC/network, KMS/certs, on-prem installer, and canary rollout. Proposed slots: Wed 2026-04-01 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET or Thu 2026-04-02 11:00 PT. Who's available? Need Eng + Infra + CS. @Alex @Tim @Sophie @Jin

Alex: I can do Wed 09:00 PT. +1 on VPC checklist — can we get the runbook updated before the call?

Tim: Thu 11:00 PT works better for me. If it's Wed I can join the second half.

Sophie: Prefer Thu too. I can prepare the canary metrics and rollback thresholds.

Jin: I have a conflict both times, can we record? If we must pick one then Thu morning only.

Maria: Ok leaning Thu 11:00 PT. Draft agenda:
1) Network / VPC peering & firewall rules — Alex
2) KMS keys + cert provisioning — Jin
3) On-prem installer & airgap considerations — Tim
4) Canary rollout plan + metrics — Sophie
5) Action items + next steps
Prep items: please confirm access to target VPC, pre-shared org IDs, and KMS key ARN. Add any blockers here. Docs: https://redwood.dev/private/deploy-checklist

Alex: Note — BluePeak requires port 4500 for KV sync. Please add to firewall checklist.

Tim: I'll update the runbook with the BluePeak-specific steps. Ping me with the pre-shared IDs and cert CNs.

Maria: Thanks. @deploy-bot tentatively schedule for 2026-04-02T11:00-11:30 PT with Zoom. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Event created (tentative): BluePeak Private deploy review — 2026-04-02 11:00 PT — invites sent to Maria, Alex, Sophie, Tim, Jin. Link: https://zoom.redwood/j/987654321 — react with :thumbsup: to confirm.

Jin: :thumbsup: I'll watch the recording if needed. Also I'll triage HSM/HSM access validation before the call.

Sophie: I'll prepare a 2-slide summary with canary thresholds and rollback triggers. ETA: EOD Monday.

Maria: Perfect — if no objections I'll mark this confirmed by EOD. Thanks all!
